deeper-life-in-christ.title: Maisha ya Ndani Zaidi: Kristo Ndani Yenu
deeper-life-in-christ.description: Si juhudi zaidi, bali Mtu: siri ya maisha ya ndani zaidi ni Kristo mwenyewe anayeishi ndani yetu. Andrew Murray anaanza kwa ajabu ya Yesu Mwenyewe, kisha anafunua maisha ya Kristo anayekaa ndani, na Hudson Taylor anahitimisha katika pumziko la muungano na ushirika pamoja na Mpendwa.
note: Every phrase here is taken from the shipped Swahili corpus rather than rendered fresh: «Kristo ndani yenu» is Colossians 1:27 as the sw books quote it, «maisha ya ndani zaidi» and «muungano» / «ushirika» are their settled terms, and «anayekaa ndani» is the wording the power-from-on-high card already uses for indwelling. «Yesu Mwenyewe» is deliberate — it is the sw title of jesus-himself-2, the first book this plan sends a reader to, so the card and the book agree.

NOTE this row cannot appear yet: seed_plans only creates a plan in a language where EVERY source book is published in it, and two of the three (the-masters-indwelling, union-and-communion) are still English-only. The prose is correct and waiting; the card goes live with whichever of those books lands second.

faith-in-the-fire.title: Mungu wa Faraja Yote: Imani Motoni
faith-in-the-fire.description: Kwa siku zile ambazo ni vigumu kuziombea. Hannah Whitall Smith juu ya Mungu wa faraja yote, na Gareth Evans juu ya kumtumaini Yule azishikaye kesho zetu — safari ya majuma matano kuelekea amani thabiti wakati maisha hayana uhakika.
note: PROVISIONAL TITLE — read this before shipping the-god-of-all-comfort.sw.

Every other entry here opens with the shipped edition's title verbatim (ar does the same: its plan reads «إله كل تعزية: إيمانٌ في الأتون» against a book titled «إله كل تعزية»). This plan's title book — the-god-of-all-comfort — has NO Swahili edition yet, so there is no shipped title to copy and «Mungu wa Faraja Yote» is this entry's own choice.
1. Whoever translates the book should adopt this title, or change this entry in the same PR. A plan card naming a book differently from the book is the drift the humility-12-days note guards.
2. The phrase renders 2 Cor 1:3, which is NOT in the Swahili corpus today, so it could not be mined and is not claimed as verbatim Union wording. Confirm it against the Bible when the book lands.
«azishikaye kesho zetu» deliberately echoes the shipped sw title of the other source book, «Anazishika Kesho Zangu».

seed_plans will not create this row yet — the-god-of-all-comfort is missing in sw and a curated plan needs ALL its books. The prose ships first on purpose: that book completing the set is exactly how #756 flipped this same plan live in Arabic, and without an entry here the row would take the ENGLISH tuple.

grace-for-every-sinner.title: Njia ya Kumwendea Mungu: Neema kwa Kila Mwenye Dhambi
grace-for-every-sinner.description: Mwezi mmoja juu ya habari njema iliyo kongwe kuliko zote. Wito wa upole wa Richard Baxter kwa wasioongoka, D. L. Moody juu ya njia ya kumwendea Mungu, na Yote ni kwa Neema ya Charles Spurgeon — miongozo iliyo wazi kuliko yote juu ya jinsi mwenye dhambi anavyookolewa, na jinsi ya kulijua hilo.
note: Same rule as humility-12-days: the title opens with «Njia ya Kumwendea Mungu», which is the shipped Swahili edition's title verbatim (books/the-way-to-god.sw.json), so the plan card names the book the way the book names itself.

Two of the three source books — a-call-to-the-unconverted and all-of-grace — have no Swahili edition yet, so seed_plans will not create this row today; it skips a plan whose books are not all present. The prose ships anyway, and deliberately: the moment either book lands in Swahili the row IS created, and without an entry here it would take the ENGLISH tuple and publish «The Way to God: Grace for Every Sinner» on the Swahili plans page. That is the #819 defect, and this is the cheap half of preventing it.

humility-12-days.title: Unyenyekevu kwa Siku 12
humility-12-days.description: Kitabu mashuhuri cha Andrew Murray kuhusu mzizi wa kila wema — sura moja fupi kila siku kwa muda wa siku kumi na mbili.
note: «the root of every virtue» is «mzizi wa kila wema» verbatim from the Swahili edition of the book itself, so the plan card and the book it sends readers to use the same phrase.

power-from-on-high.title: Nguvu kutoka Juu: Roho Mtakatifu
power-from-on-high.description: Wiki nne pamoja na R. A. Torrey kuhusu maisha yaliyojaa Roho: kwanza ubatizo wa Roho Mtakatifu na nguvu unazoleta kwa ajili ya huduma, kisha uchunguzi kamili zaidi wa Nafsi na kazi ya Roho anayekaa ndani ya kila mwamini.

school-of-prayer.title: Misingi ya Maombi
school-of-prayer.description: Wiki nne za kujenga misingi ya maombi pamoja na waelekezi watatu: Andrew Murray kuhusu jinsi Bwana mwenyewe anavyotufundisha kuomba, D. L. Moody kuhusu maombi yenye kushinda, na Hannah Buyinza kuhusu maombi kama mapigo ya kila siku ya maisha ya Mkristo.
note: 2026-10-01: retitled from «Shule ya Maombi» to follow the English rename «A School of Prayer» → «Foundations in Prayer». AI-drafted; the description's opening «Wiki nne katika shule ya maombi» became «Wiki nne za kujenga misingi ya maombi» to match.

the-inner-chamber-month.title: Mwezi katika Chumba cha Ndani
the-inner-chamber-month.description: Jenga tabia ya kila siku ya maombi na Neno: asubuhi thelathini na sita pamoja na Andrew Murray, sura moja kila siku.
note: Found while shipping the deeper-life-in-christ row, and live: the-inner-chamber is published in Swahili, so seed_plans had already created the sw plan — taking the ENGLISH tuple, because no sw entry existed. The sw plans page had been reading «A Month in the Inner Chamber». Nothing failed; that was the documented fallback, and it was silent. «Chumba cha Ndani» is the sw title of the book itself, so card and book agree.
es and uk had the same row and the same gap — reported, not fixed in that job, because it was Swahili.

everything-for-christ.title: Kila Kitu kwa Ajili ya Kristo: Maisha Yaliyomiminwa
everything-for-christ.description: Kujisalimisha kwa moyo wote kunagharimu nini, na kunazaa nini? Shajara ya kimisionari ya David Brainerd ipekuayo moyo, ikifuatiwa na hadithi za wanaume na wanawake waliotoa kila kitu kwa ajili ya injili — wito wa kujiweka wakfu unaosimuliwa kupitia maisha yaliyouitikia.
note: PROVISIONAL TITLE. This curated plan's two source books — life-and-diary-of-david-brainerd and men-and-women-who-gave-everything-2 — have NO Swahili edition yet, so there is no shipped book title to quote. «Maisha Yaliyomiminwa» renders the plan's own subtitle 'A Life Poured Out'; «Kujisalimisha» is the glossary term for 'surrender'.

seed_plans will NOT create this row today: a curated plan needs EVERY source book present in the language, and both are still English-only. The prose ships now, deliberately, so that the moment both books land in Swahili the row is created with this wording rather than falling back to the ENGLISH tuple (the #819 defect). Whoever translates either book should adopt this title as the card's prefix, or update this entry in the same PR.
Written for job #1736.

growing-in-wisdom-18-days.title: Kukua katika Hekima kwa Siku 18
growing-in-wisdom-18-days.description: Mwongozo wa James DeGreef kwa wanafunzi — somo moja fupi kila siku kwa siku kumi na nane. Kuanzia kugundua kusudi lako hadi kujenga maono ya wakati ujao, kila siku huunganisha ushauri wa vitendo na Andiko, tafakari, na sala.

christ-our-healer.title: Kristo Mponyaji Wetu
christ-our-healer.description: Wiki sita juu ya Kristo kama Mwokozi, Mtakasaji, Mponyaji, na Mfalme Ajaye. A. B. Simpson anaeleza injili nne na huduma yake ya uponyaji katika «Injili Nne» na «Injili ya Uponyaji», na Andrew Murray anahitimisha kwa mwezi wa tafakari juu ya Bwana anayeuponya mwili katika «Uponyaji wa Kimungu».
note: The description names the three source books the way their shipped Swahili editions do — «Injili Nne» (the-fourfold-gospel.sw), «Injili ya Uponyaji» (the-gospel-of-healing.sw) and «Uponyaji wa Kimungu» (divine-healing.sw), all fixture titles verbatim — so the plan card and the books it opens agree.

All three source books are ALREADY published in sw, so seed_plans creates this (christ-our-healer, sw) row on the same deploy that adds the plan — this prose must land in the SAME PR as the English definition or the sw plans page publishes the English card (the #819 defect).

brave-for-god-24-true-stories.title: Jasiri kwa ajili ya Mungu: Hadithi 24 za Kweli
brave-for-god-24-true-stories.description: Majuma matatu na nusu ya hadithi za kweli kwa wasomaji wadogo, moja kila siku: vitabu vyote vinne vya Jasiri kwa ajili ya Mungu — watu ishirini na wanne wa kawaida kutoka kila pembe ya dunia waliomtumaini Mungu wakafanywa jasiri.
note: AI-drafted; awaiting native review. The series name is quoted verbatim from the shipped Swahili book titles ("Jasiri kwa ajili ya Mungu", Kitabu cha Pili/Tatu/Nne).

waiting-on-god-trust.title: Kumngojea Mungu: Maisha ya Kumtumaini
waiting-on-god-trust.description: Wiki kumi katika shule ya kumtumaini Mungu. Andrew Murray anafundisha nidhamu ya kila siku ya kumngojea Mungu, F. B. Meyer anafunua siri ya kuongozwa naye, na maisha ya ajabu ya imani ya George Müller yanaonyesha kile ambacho tumaini la namna hiyo hupokea.
note: The title joins the sw titles of two of its three books — «Kumngojea Mungu» (waiting-on-god, and the corpus's settled verb: 80 uses of «kumngojea Mungu» against 12 of «kumngoja») and «Maisha ya Kumtumaini Mungu» (the-life-of-trust) — so the card and the books agree.
«siri ya kuongozwa» echoes «Siri ya Uongozi», the sw title of the-secret-of-guidance; «shule» follows the Shule ya Maombi card.

school-of-prayer-31-days.title: Siku 31 katika Shule ya Maombi
school-of-prayer-31-days.description: Mwezi mzima pamoja na Andrew Murray miguuni pa Mwalimu pekee. Kila siku hufungua moja ya maneno ya Yesu mwenyewe kuhusu maombi, kuanzia “Bwana, utufundishe kuomba” hadi ahadi za usiku ule wa mwisho, nayo huishia katika sala yake yenyewe. Somo moja kwa siku, kama dakika kumi, likijenga kuelekea maombezi na maisha ya maombi.
note: Single-book plan backed by the sw edition of school-of-prayer (book title “Pamoja na Kristo katika Shule ya Maombi”); the card phrase “Shule ya Maombi” matches the shipped book title, and “Bwana, utufundishe kuomba” is the SUV Luke 11:1 wording the book uses. Added by the book:school-of-prayer -> sw job (#3148), which makes this LAUNCH plan creatable in sw.

first-steps-for-teens.title: Hatua za Kwanza: Imani kwa Vijana
first-steps-for-teens.description: Matembezi ya kwanza pamoja na Yesu, kwa wasomaji vijana. Charles Spurgeon anakukaribisha langoni kwa msaada ulio rahisi kabisa kwa yeyote anayetafuta njia yake kwa Kristo; kisha hadithi za kweli za wanaume na wanawake waliomtolea Yeye yote zinaonyesha jinsi maisha hayo yanavyokuwa — vitabu viwili vifupi kwa muda wa takribani wiki tatu.
note: Job #2788. Source books: around-the-wicket-gate (Swahili edition shipped, «Karibu na Lango Jembamba») and men-and-women-who-gave-everything-2 (Swahili edition shipped in THIS PR, «Wanaume na Wanawake Waliotoa Yote»). With men-and-women now in sw, both source books are published in Swahili, so seed_plans creates the (first-steps-for-teens, sw) row — hence the prose must ship in this same PR. Title/description echo the shipped Swahili book titles («langoni» for the wicket gate, «wanaume na wanawake waliomtolea Yeye yote» for the biographies).

family-devotions-pilgrims-journey.title: Ibada ya Familia: Safari ya Msafiri
family-devotions-pilgrims-journey.description: Ibada za familia za dakika tano kwa watoto na watu wazima wanaosoma pamoja nao, kwa takriban usiku wa wiki tatu na nusu. Someni kwa sauti sura moja fupi: kwanza msafiri wa Bunyan katika njia ya kwenda mji wa mbinguni, kisha picha za shambani za Spurgeon. Kila sura inamalizika kwa sala na maswali matatu ya kuzungumza pamoja.
note: AI-drafted ahead of the books; awaiting native review. Shipped before the five children's editions are translated into this language so their translation jobs never write this shared file: seed_plans creates the row only once every source book is published here. Like the English, it describes the books rather than quoting their titles, so it cannot disagree with whatever title each edition ships under.

family-devotions-heroes-who-trusted-god.title: Ibada ya Familia: Mashujaa Waliomtumaini Mungu
family-devotions-heroes-who-trusted-god.description: Wiki tano za ibada za familia za dakika tano: hadithi za kweli za watu watatu waliomtumaini Mungu kwa kila kitu, zikisomwa kwa sauti sura moja fupi kila usiku — George Müller na yatima wake, Hudson Taylor akiwa njiani kwenda China, na Amanda Smith, aliyezaliwa utumwani, aliyeomba apate jozi ya viatu. Kila sura inamalizika kwa sala na maswali matatu ya kuzungumza pamoja.
note: AI-drafted ahead of the books; awaiting native review. Shipped before the five children's editions are translated into this language so their translation jobs never write this shared file: seed_plans creates the row only once every source book is published here. Like the English, it describes the books rather than quoting their titles, so it cannot disagree with whatever title each edition ships under.

family-devotions-talking-with-god.title: Ibada ya Familia: Kuzungumza na Mungu Mchana Kutwa
family-devotions-talking-with-god.description: Usiku kumi na mbili wa ibada za familia za dakika tano pamoja na Ndugu Lorenzo, msaidizi wa jikoni asiye na ustadi aliyejifunza kuzungumza na Mungu katikati ya vyungu na sufuria. Someni kwa sauti sura moja fupi: jinsi mti usio na majani wakati wa baridi ulivyomgeuza kwa Mungu, jinsi alivyofanya kila kazi kwa ajili ya upendo wa Mungu, na alichofanya alipokosea. Kila sura inamalizika kwa sala na maswali matatu ya kuzungumza pamoja.
note: AI-drafted ahead of the book; awaiting native review. Shipped before the children's Practice of the Presence of God is translated into this language, so that job never writes this shared file: seed_plans creates the row only once the book is published here. Like the English, it describes the book rather than quoting a title that does not exist yet.

family-devotions-brave-and-faithful.title: Ibada za familia: jasiri na waaminifu
family-devotions-brave-and-faithful.description: Wiki tano za ibada fupi za familia za dakika tano: hadithi za kweli za wanawake watatu jasiri, zinazosomwa kwa sauti sura moja fupi kila usiku — Mary Slessor, msichana wa viwandani kutoka Scotland aliyewaokoa watoto mapacha nchini Nigeria; Pandita Ramabai, aliyejenga makao kwa ajili ya wajane na wasichana wa India; na Corrie ten Boom, aliyewaficha majirani zake Wayahudi wakati wa vita na akajifunza kusamehe. Kila sura inaishia kwa sala na maswali matatu ya kuzungumza pamoja.
note: AI-drafted ahead of the books; awaiting native review. Shipped before the three children's editions are translated into this language, so those jobs never write this shared file: seed_plans creates the row only once all three books are published here. Like the English, it describes the books rather than quoting titles that do not exist yet.

family-devotions-boy-from-osogun.title: Ibada ya Familia: Mvulana wa Osogun
family-devotions-boy-from-osogun.description: Usiku kumi na mbili wa ibada za familia za dakika tano pamoja na Samuel Ajayi Crowther, mvulana Myoruba aliyeuzwa kama mtumwa, naye alikua akawapa watu wake Biblia katika lugha yao wenyewe. Someni kwa sauti sura moja fupi: meli ya watumwa iliyosimamishwa baharini, siku alipompata tena mama yake, Sala ya Bwana kwa Kiyoruba mbele ya Malkia, na watumwa wema waliomlisha alipokuwa mateka. Kila sura inamalizika kwa sala na maswali matatu ya kuzungumza pamoja.
note: AI-drafted with the book, job #5421; awaiting native review. The title quotes the Swahili edition's first chapter, «Mvulana wa Osogun» (samuel-ajayi-crowther-a-life-children.sw, chapter 1), as the English plan quotes “The Boy from Osogun”; the description's framing (“Usiku kumi na mbili wa ibada za familia za dakika tano… Kila sura inamalizika kwa sala na maswali matatu ya kuzungumza pamoja”) matches family-devotions-talking-with-god so the family-devotions shelf reads as one voice. «Sala ya Bwana» and «Malkia» follow the edition's chapter 8.

new-to-the-faith.title: Mpya katika Imani
new-to-the-faith.description: Wiki tano na nusu kwa yeyote anayeanza tu safari yake pamoja na Kristo. Charles Spurgeon anakulaki langoni kwa msaada ulio rahisi kabisa wa kumtumaini Yesu; kisha R. A. Torrey, akiwaandikia waamini wapya, anaonyesha jinsi ya kuanza vizuri — uhakika wa wokovu, Roho Mtakatifu, kanisa, Biblia, maombi na kushuhudia. Makala fupi njiani zinajibu maswali ambayo kila Mkristo mpya huuliza: injili ni nini, kwa nini Yesu alikufa, ubatizo na Meza ya Bwana vina maana gani, na jinsi ya kuendelea kukua.
note: Job #5108. The English title names no book, so the Swahili title is a plain rendering, not a quoted edition title.

«langoni» is the wicket gate as the shipped corpus says it (Karibu na Lango Jembamba = around-the-wicket-gate.sw; pilgrims-progress.sw uses «langoni» throughout), the same word the first-steps-for-teens card uses for this same book. «injili ni nini» echoes the shipped article title «Injili Ni Nini?»; «waamini wapya» and «Meza ya Bwana» are the corpus's settled terms. 'assurance' is rendered «uhakika wa wokovu», the usual Swahili name for the doctrine (bare «uhakika» reads as mere 'certainty').

seed_plans will not create this row yet — a curated plan needs EVERY source book published in the language, and how-to-succeed-in-the-christian-life (book) and the articles why-did-jesus-die, what-is-grace, what-is-repentance, what-is-baptism, what-is-the-church, what-is-the-lords-supper, how-to-read-the-bible-for-beginners, how-to-share-your-faith, how-to-overcome-sin-and-temptation, how-to-grow-in-your-faith are still English-only. The prose ships first on purpose: the moment the set completes the row IS created, and without an entry here it would take the ENGLISH tuple and publish «New to the Faith» on the Swahili plans page (the #819 defect).

praying-men.title: Watu wa Maombi: Shule ya Maombi pamoja na E. M. Bounds
praying-men.description: Wiki saba katika tanuru la maombezi pamoja na mtume mkuu wa maombi. E. M. Bounds anaanza na hitaji la mhubiri mwenyewe la nguvu, kisha anafunua kusudi linalofanya maombi yashinde, na ulazima unaoyafanya kuwa kazi nzima ya maisha ya Mkristo.
note: Job #5109. «Watu wa Maombi» is Bounds's own phrase as the shipped Swahili edition of Power Through Prayer («Nguvu Kupitia Maombi», power-through-prayer.sw) renders it — 16 uses there — so the card speaks the book's language. «Shule ya Maombi» matches the shipped sw title of school-of-prayer («Pamoja na Kristo katika Shule ya Maombi») and the school-of-prayer-31-days card; «maombezi» is the glossary term for intercession.

The title does not open with a book title, so nothing here is provisional. «kusudi» and «ulazima» describe the second and third books; they are not quoted titles, so whoever translates purpose-in-prayer / necessity-of-prayer is free to title them.

seed_plans will not create this row yet — a curated plan needs EVERY source book published in the language, and purpose-in-prayer, necessity-of-prayer are still English-only. The prose ships first on purpose: the moment the set completes the row IS created, and without an entry here it would take the ENGLISH tuple and publish «Praying Men: A School of Prayer with E. M. Bounds» on the Swahili plans page (the #819 defect).

voices-of-the-early-church.title: Sauti za Kanisa la Kwanza
voices-of-the-early-church.description: Karne za kwanza za Kikristo kwa maneno yao wenyewe. Clement wa Roma anaandika kutoka kanisa la Roma wakati kizazi cha mitume wenyewe kilikuwa bado hai, Ignatius wa Antiokia anatuma barua zake akiwa njiani kuelekea kifo cha kishahidi, na Athanasius wa Aleksandria anaeleza kiini cha imani — kwa nini Mungu mwenyewe alifanyika mwanadamu — katika «Kuhusu Kufanyika Mwili». Masomo mafupi ya kila siku kwa takriban miezi minne.
note: Job #5110. PROVISIONAL BOOK TITLE: the description names Athanasius's On the Incarnation, which has NO Swahili edition yet, so «Kuhusu Kufanyika Mwili» is this entry's own choice («kufanyika mwili» is the corpus's term for the incarnation, after John 1:14 «Neno alifanyika mwili» as rooted-2.sw and confessions.sw quote it). Whoever translates on-the-incarnation should adopt it, or change this entry in the same PR — a card naming a book differently from the book is the drift the humility-12-days note guards.

Names stay in their English form (Clement, Ignatius, Athanasius); the cities take the corpus's Swahili forms «Roma», «Antiokia» (24 uses) and «Aleksandria» (as the shipped sw corpus names Athanasius's see).

rooted-three-months-books-1-3.title: Wenye Mizizi: Miezi Mitatu na Mungu — Vitabu 1–3
rooted-three-months-books-1-3.description: Miezi mitatu na Mungu kwa wasomaji wenye umri wa miaka 9 hadi 12: vitabu vitatu vya kwanza vya Wenye Mizizi — Kupandwa, Kumfuata Yesu na Kukuza Matunda — ibada moja fupi kila siku kuhusu Mungu ni nani na habari njema za Yesu, kutembea pamoja Naye kuanzia horini hadi kwenye kaburi tupu, na kukuza tunda la Roho.
note: Job #5112. «Wenye Mizizi» is the series name verbatim from the shipped sw titles («Wenye Mizizi – Siku 30 na Mungu kwa Vijana – Kitabu cha 1/2»); «Miezi Mitatu na Mungu» follows their «Siku 30 na Mungu». «Kupandwa» and «Kumfuata Yesu» are the shipped subtitles of rooted-1.sw and rooted-2.sw verbatim, and «kuanzia horini hadi kwenye kaburi tupu» is rooted-2.sw's subtitle wording.

PROVISIONAL: «Kukuza Matunda» renders Book 3's 'Growing Fruit', and rooted-3 has NO Swahili edition yet. Whoever translates rooted-3 should give it this subtitle (in the same verb-noun shape as Kupandwa / Kumfuata Yesu), or change this entry in the same PR. «tunda la Roho» is Galatians 5:22 as the shipped corpus quotes it (46 uses in absolute-surrender.sw alone).

The prose ships first on purpose: the moment the set completes the row IS created, and without an entry here it would take the ENGLISH tuple and publish «Rooted: Three Months with God — Books 1–3» on the Swahili plans page (the #819 defect).

the-puritan-heart.title: Moyo wa Kipuritani
the-puritan-heart.description: Wiki nane pamoja na mabingwa watatu wa maisha ya ndani. Richard Sibbes anauganga mwanzi uliopondeka, John Owen anapigana vita dhidi ya dhambi ambayo bado inakaa ndani yetu, na Thomas Watson analiweka pambano lote juu ya ahadi kwamba mambo yote hufanya kazi pamoja kwa mema.
note: Job #5113. «Kipuritani» is the corpus's adjective (Wapuritani / Kipuritani in the shipped sw books); «maisha ya ndani» is the settled term for the inner life. «mwanzi uliopondeka» is Isaiah 42:3 verbatim as the shipped corpus quotes it («Mwanzi uliopondeka hatauvunja…»).

The Romans 8:28 echo borrows the corpus's key words («hufanya kazi pamoja», «mema») but is a shortened form, NOT the verbatim verse (the corpus has «katika mambo yote Mungu hufanya kazi pamoja na wale wampendao katika kuwapatia mema»), because the English card uses the short proverb form too.
No book title is quoted, so nothing here is provisional.

pursuit-of-holiness.title: Kuutafuta Utakatifu
pursuit-of-holiness.description: Wiki tisa juu ya kuwa mali ya Bwana kikamilifu. Andrew Murray anaufuatilia utakatifu wetu hadi kwenye muungano wetu na Yule Mtakatifu, William Law anatuita kwenye maisha ya utauwa katika kila saa ya kawaida, na John Wesley anaeleza waziwazi ukamilifu wa Kikristo ni nini — na sio nini.
note: Job #5114. «Kuutafuta Utakatifu» leans on Hebrews 12:14 as the shipped corpus quotes it («Tafuteni kwa bidii … huo utakatifu»). «Yule Mtakatifu» is the wording of the shipped Murray edition this plan opens with («Mtakatifu katika Kristo», holy-in-christ.sw — 68 uses); «mali ya Bwana», «utauwa» (glossary: godliness/devout) and «ukamilifu wa Kikristo» are corpus terms.

send-the-fire.title: Tuma Moto: Kuombea Uamsho
send-the-fire.description: Jinsi uamsho unavyokuja, na jinsi ya kuuombea ushuke. Mihadhara ya Charles Finney juu ya masharti ya uamsho, R. A. Torrey juu ya ubatizo wa Roho Mtakatifu unaoutia nguvu, na mahubiri ambayo kwayo Mungu aliitikisa New England chini ya Jonathan Edwards.

key-teachings-four-teachers.title: Mafundisho Makuu: Walimu Wanne
key-teachings-four-teachers.description: Wiki kumi na mbili pamoja na walimu wanne, sura moja fupi kila siku, kila moja ikimalizika kwa maswali na sala: Richard Baxter juu ya pumziko la milele la watakatifu, Jonathan Edwards juu ya uzuri wa Mungu na dini ya kweli, A. B. Simpson juu ya Kristo Mwokozi wetu, Mtakasaji, Mponyaji na Mfalme Ajaye, na Watchman Nee juu ya maisha ya kawaida ya Kikristo.

the-pilgrims-way.title: Njia ya Msafiri
the-pilgrims-way.description: Njia ya kurudi nyumbani, katika vitabu vitatu mashuhuri vya kale. Charles Spurgeon anamlaki mtafutaji langoni, hadithi ya mfano isiyokufa ya John Bunyan inamfuata msafiri njia nzima hadi Mji wa Mbinguni, na ushuhuda wa Bunyan mwenyewe unaonyesha neema iliyozidi kuwa nyingi kwa mkuu wa wenye dhambi.
note: Job #5117. «Njia ya Msafiri» deliberately echoes the shipped sw title of The Pilgrim's Progress, «Safari ya Msafiri» (pilgrims-progress.sw), as the English 'Pilgrim's Way' echoes 'Pilgrim's Progress'. «langoni» (the wicket gate; Karibu na Lango Jembamba = around-the-wicket-gate.sw) and «Mji wa Mbinguni» (the Celestial City) are the shipped Swahili Pilgrim's Progress's own words.

«neema iliyozidi kuwa nyingi» is Romans 5:20 as the corpus quotes it («neema ilizidi kuwa nyingi zaidi»), and «mkuu wa wenye dhambi» is corpus wording for 1 Tim 1:15's 'chief of sinners'. These describe Grace Abounding rather than quote a title; whoever translates grace-abounding may find «Neema Iliyozidi kwa Mkuu wa Wenye Dhambi» a fit that keeps this card in step, but nothing here binds it.
